Persian MT-Bench
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

Persian MT-Bench is a localized and culturally adapted version of the MT-Bench multi-turn dialogue evaluation dataset, fully translated and rewritten in Persian. MT-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating language models in multi-turn, dialogue-style question answering. The Persian version preserves the original structure while adapting content for Persian-speaking users, both linguistically and culturally.
